title: Next.js gives 404 on Intercepting Routes with nested route groups

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/fedetorre/nextgram

### To Reproduce

I have a complex nextjs project with the same problem, I tried to reproduce my project structure with the nextgram demo for debugging purpuse.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Checkout the project
2. yarn install
3. yarn dev
4. Open the browser on [localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)
5. Click to an image, the url change but renders the 404 page, in the [original nextgram demo](https://github.com/vercel-labs/nextgram) a modal will be open with the clicked image
6. If you refresh the page the image appear and the server does not give 404


### Current vs. Expected behavior

I'm expecting that the modal opens with the image and the 404 page will not be rendered.

### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
  Platform: linux
  Arch: x64
  Version: #38~22.04.1-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu Nov  2 18:01:13 UTC 2

```

Not sure, App Router
